svg.text: User opens the app over HTTPS; request reaches the ALB via the Internet Gateway.
ALB finds no session cookie and redirects the browser to Okta /authorize.
User signs in at Okta (SSO / MFA); Okta checks the user is assigned to the app.
Okta redirects the browser back to the ALB at /oauth2/idpresponse with an auth code.
ALB exchanges the code at Okta's token endpoint and fetches userinfo (incl. groups).
ALB sets its session cookie and forwards to UI / API with x-amzn-oidc-* headers.
API verifies the ALB-signed JWT and enforces RBAC from the Okta groups claim.
